title: This is probably the most creative and beautiful vibe coded game i've played.
author: cointalkz
selftext:
Super unique RPG game where you paint the world as you go and explore. I'm pretty bad at RPG games as a whole but this had me hooked. I cut a small trailer of some game play (I didn't add too many spoilers since that is half the fun). I believe it is fully multiplayer as well so you can explore with friends (RIP I have none, anyone wanna play with me). It's free to play in browser as well, give it a try if it looks cool to you or let me know if you wanna explore with me!

  
[https://www.spawn.co/?box=@gfta/inkblade](https://www.spawn.co/?box=@gfta/inkblade)
